blocks.text: **First oracle candidate for the reduced scenario — 00G-HF-ORACLE-C1 (1 Oct 2026):** [candidate record and test-entry instructions](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.2/CANDIDATE.md). C1 selects the audited v0.2 outcome evaluator for both negative and positive 00G-HF traversals. Its 60 public controls test the evaluator, not candidate agents; external review and harness integration remain pending. This is scoped to the reduced instance and does not replace the full 00G branch oracle.

**Expanded oracle candidate — C2 / v0.3 (1 Oct 2026):** [candidate and package](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/CANDIDATE.md). Preserves C1 outcome predicates and 60 controls; adds 28 controls for timing and credential diagnostics, an independent-annotation protocol and an explicit population-scope boundary. 88/88 author controls pass; no agent runs, real-time prevention or swarm validation are claimed. C1 remains available unchanged.

**Bounded first-round preparation — C3 / v0.4:** [candidate](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/CANDIDATE.md) · [two-control, six-cell protocol](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/ROUND1_PROTOCOL.md). Uses the OAI-G1 reference with initial G2 context variations; preserves existing outcome predicates and adds 14 author controls (102 total). This is partial exploratory E1 preparation, not agent execution, historical equivalence or full 00G validation. Earlier candidates remain intact.

**Primer candidato de oráculo — 00G-HF-ORACLE-C1:** [ficha, paquete auditado y preparación de las pruebas](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.2/CANDIDATE.md). Se propone la v0.2 para adjudicar los recorridos negativos y positivos de esta reducción con las mismas reglas. La ficha fija versión, huellas, entradas/salidas y secuencia para iniciar E1; distingue los 60 controles del evaluador de las ejecuciones con agentes y mantiene las condiciones pendientes de validación externa.

**Candidato ampliado — C2 / v0.3:** [ficha y paquete](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/CANDIDATE.md). Conserva el núcleo y los 60 controles de C1; añade 28 controles de latencia/credenciales, una rúbrica de anotación independiente y el límite explícito del alcance colectivo. Resultado: 88/88 controles del autor, cero ejecuciones con agentes. C2 se propone para nuevos ensayos exploratorios; C1 permanece íntegro.

**Candidato preparado para la primera ronda — C3 / v0.4:** [paquete y límites](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/CANDIDATE.md). Acota autoridad y aplicabilidad ante cambio de contexto en seis celdas; conserva los criterios de C2 y añade 14 controles construidos, 102 en total. El siguiente paso es completar la implementación y registrar seis episodios exploratorios, no ampliar indefinidamente el protocolo. No hay ejecuciones de agentes ni equivalencia histórica demostrada.

**Primer recorrido documental — 1 de octubre de 2026:** [seis unidades de evidencia histórica y límites de adjudicación](./traversals/00G-HF-HISTORICAL-REVIEW-2026-10-01/README.md). Incluye contención favorable y rivales causales. Es revisión retrospectiva, no ejecución nueva: faltan datos para puntuar trazas históricas completas con C3. La ejecución viva sigue pendiente de receptor y acceso autorizado; no se ha cambiado el oráculo.

**Auditoría ejecutable adicional — 1 de octubre de 2026:** [comprobaciones metamórficas y ejecución en Codex](./audits/00G-HF-C3-METAMORPHIC-2026-10-01/README.md). Pasan 70/70 variaciones sobre 14 trazas construidas; se verifican identificadores, permisos futuros, duplicación de evidencia y cobertura incompleta. Refuerza la consistencia del evaluador; no son ejecuciones de agentes ni evidencia de eficacia de EA. C3 permanece congelado.

**Receptor nativo implementado — 1 de octubre de 2026:** [paquete ejecutable v0.1, código, instrucciones y resultados](./fixtures/00G-HF-NATIVE-v0.1/README.md). Incluye adaptador Responses, controles convencionales, registro externo al receptor y comprobación de finalización. Pasan 19/19 controles programados de integración. El intento de iniciar el piloto quedó bloqueado antes de llamar al modelo: faltan API key configurada y modelo seleccionado. Cero episodios reales; no se declara E1 superado ni eficacia de EA. El oráculo C3 permanece intacto.

**Implementación en paralelo:** [plan de trabajo EA + receptor nativo](./implementation/00G-HF-PARALLEL-v0.1/README.md) · [empezar desde Codex](./implementation/00G-HF-PARALLEL-v0.1/CODEX_START_HERE.md). Define carpetas separadas y condiciones de integración; no añade resultados empíricos.

**Componente EA ejecutado — continuación del 1 de octubre:** [v0.1 de calificación](./fixtures/00G-HF-EA-COMPONENT-v0.1/README.md) y [v0.2 temporal con adaptación conservadora](./fixtures/00G-HF-EA-COMPONENT-v0.2/README.md). Resultados revisados: 22/22 + 8/8 en v0.1; 20/20 + 17/17 en v0.2, incluidos seis recorridos programados de consultas a servicios. Se conservan el primer fallo de adaptación y su corrección. Los servicios nativos no aportan versión ni vigencia futura: se mantienen ausentes. Son pruebas del componente; cero decisiones de modelo y comparación nativo/EA pendiente.

**Recorrido integrado programado — 1 de octubre:** [comparación pareada sin/con EA y evaluación T1–T4](./traversals/00G-HF-SCRIPTED-PAIRED-v0.1/RESULTS.md). Se ejecutaron ocho pares: nativo completa 8/8 tareas y nativo+EA 7/8. Ambos superan las seis celdas principales y mantienen los predicados de seguridad en los 16 recorridos. El coste de EA consume el margen en el límite de plazo corto. Se publicaron diseño y expectativas antes de ejecutar; no hubo decisiones de modelo. El resultado no muestra necesidad ni beneficio adicional de EA en este alcance; la comparación empírica permanece pendiente.

**Primer oráculo público:** [00G-HF oracle v0.1](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.1/README.md) · [copia Word](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.1/00G_HF_Oraculo_v0.1.docx). Fija mundo, evidencias y adjudicación; sus 28 controles verifican el evaluador sobre trazas construidas por el autor. No son ejecuciones E1 de agentes ni validación externa o ciega. La revisión externa y la integración del receptor siguen pendientes.

**Revisión auditada para ambos recorridos:** [oráculo v0.2](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.2/README.md) · [auditoría y matriz de negativos/positivos](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.2/AUDIT.md) · [informe Word](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.2/00G_HF_Auditoria_Oraculo_v0.2.docx). Corrige la legitimidad de la finalización, separa mandato de tarea y acceso, e incorpora espera, recualificación y reentrada. Sus 60 controles públicos comprueban el evaluador; no son ejecuciones con agentes ni validación externa. Conserva íntegra v0.1 y sus resultados. El alcance y las puertas pendientes figuran en la auditoría.

**Ampliación C2 / v0.3:** [oráculo](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/README.md) · [rúbrica de reconocimiento de límites](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md) · [perfiles temporal y colectivo](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/EXPERIMENT_PROFILES.md). Conserva la adjudicación de C1, separa aceptación de credenciales y autoridad, e incorpora diagnóstico temporal sin atribuir prevención a una respuesta puntual. 88/88 controles públicos del autor; cero ejecuciones con agentes. La unidad sigue siendo individual; la prueba colectiva y las anotaciones humanas están pendientes. Esta ampliación no altera E1–E5 ni los hechos del escenario.

**Preparación acotada C3 / v0.4:** [ronda inicial de dos controles](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/ROUND1_PROTOCOL.md) · [registro del ensayo](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/RUN_REGISTRATION_TEMPLATE.json). Concreta una parte exploratoria de E1: seis celdas, implementación OAI-G1 conservada ante cambios de autoridad/aplicabilidad, modalidad extremo a extremo y positivos de reentrada. Las retiradas, el enjambre y los contrastes H2–H5 quedan separados. C3 es el ID del oráculo, no el brazo EA C3 de §5. Sus 102 controles prueban el evaluador; la implementación y ejecución real siguen pendientes.

**Prepared first-round candidate — C3 / v0.4 (1 October 2026):** [current preparation package](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/CANDIDATE.md). Two controls under context change, six planned exploratory episodes; 102 constructed oracle checks, no agent runs. Preserves C1/C2 and requires a concrete receiver and run registration before execution.

**00G-HF oracle update — C2 / v0.3 (1 October 2026):** [current expanded candidate](./fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/CANDIDATE.md) for the [reduced scenario](./00G_HF_ONE_WAY_REDUCTION_AND_EXTENSIBILITY_v0.1_DRAFT.md). Preserves C1; adds timing/credential diagnostics, an annotation protocol and explicit collective-scope limits. 88/88 public author controls; no agent runs or population validation.

#### W3-HF — Preliminary assessment of H2–H5 in the reduced 00G-HF scenario

**Native implementation update — 1 October 2026:** [native receiver candidate v0.1](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-NATIVE-v0.1/README.md) now implements a Responses API adapter, conventional application guards, current-state services, host-owned recorder and independent completion checking for the six C3 cells. **19/19 scripted integration controls passed.** The [pilot entry-point report](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-NATIVE-v0.1/runs/2026-10-01-access-check/REPORT.json) records `BLOCKED_BEFORE_MODEL_EXECUTION`: no configured API key and no selected model; zero model requests and zero model episodes. Live API compatibility, independent comparator review and A25 admission remain pending. This is an author application candidate, not OpenAI default policy, historical reproduction or executed E1. The source, instructions, registration and freeze are published with the report.

**Parallel implementation handoff — 1 October 2026:** [implementation plan](./baseline/implementation/00G-HF-PARALLEL-v0.1/README.md) and [Codex entry point](./baseline/implementation/00G-HF-PARALLEL-v0.1/CODEX_START_HERE.md) now specify independent work areas, native execution commands, evidence delivery and later paired integration. Codex can prepare/run the native lane while this conversation implements the bounded EA component; actual model access remains a separate prerequisite. No new model execution is claimed.

##### Current priority — two execution lanes, without waiting for a model connection

**Scheduling update — 1 October 2026:** proceed now with requirements and executable component work that does not need Codex or a model API. Couple a concrete model receiver later. This separates dependencies; it does not relax the empirical gates below or turn author-built simulations into agent trials. “Independent of the model connection” does **not** mean independently authored, externally validated or blind.

**Lane A — available now: bounded EA contract and model-independent tests.** Start from [canonical S/T/H requirements](./baseline/00_CANONICAL_REQUIREMENTS_CHALLENGES_SUFFICIENCY_HYPOTHESES_KPIS.md), the traceability register and [causal protocol §§5–8](./baseline/00G_HF_CAUSAL_NEGATIVE_TRAVERSAL_PROTOCOL_v0.3_DRAFT.md). Do not redesign EA as the owner of authorization, enforcement or escalation.

1. **Freeze observable inputs and the semantic output contract.** Use the protocol's existing fields: decision/recipient; basis/version/scope; event/source/dependencies; evidence versus instruction; sufficiency or UNKNOWN; externally grounded authority or pending verification; residual; targeted check; emission, reception and last useful time. Specify what each field can actually be derived from. Keep future events, case labels and adjudicator-only truth out of the candidate. A residual field is not a calibrated probability.
2. **Implement a bounded EA component and test its information limits.** Register expected properties from the requirements and world facts before the candidate runs. Cover legitimate unchanged operation, legitimate transition, visible authority/applicability change, source-dependence change, stale or absent evidence, and delivery after the last useful time. Include a pair of materially different worlds with identical observable input: EA cannot reliably distinguish them without an additional observation. UNKNOWN must not be scored as successful detection, and blanket refusal must fail legitimate continuity. The existing six C3 cells are a starting scope, not complete coverage of these cases.
3. **Separate signal quality from receiver response.** Score whether a signal is justified, preserves material distinctions and arrives in time. Then exercise explicitly stipulated consumer policies: conventional controls already suffice; a receiver uses the signal and rechecks; a receiver receives the signal but proceeds anyway. These are executable software/model tests, not observations of how an OpenAI model decides. Report conditional prevention separately from signal correctness. Give conventional controls the same eligible evidence and resource envelope; do not manufacture an EA advantage by hiding the source from them.
4. **Prepare composition contracts after the EA component.** Model basic S0 delivery separately from added incident lifecycle, human escalation and population input. Specify availability, latency, authority, failure and budget assumptions and test each addition separately, including absent/late response. A simulated human response is a fixture, not a human evaluation. Preserve an equivalent composition without EA semantics where necessity is the question.

**Lane A bounded delivery — 1 October 2026:** [v0.1 qualification component](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-EA-COMPONENT-v0.1/README.md) records 22/22 cases + 8/8 reviewed supplemental checks; its [v0.2 temporal successor and native-service projection](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-EA-COMPONENT-v0.2/README.md) records 20/20 temporal cases + 17/17 supplemental checks, including six scripted service sequences. The first v0.2 run's failed scope-rejection test is preserved with source, correction and rerun. Both packages have contracts, expected fixtures, manifests and actual outputs. v0.1 had been prepared locally but was not present on main at c8672ae; this update publishes it without claiming earlier public availability. These are author software checks, not agent episodes. Temporal comparison distinguishes qualification loss, point-value changes and metadata refresh; identical endpoints do not reveal hidden/transient change. The adapter preserves missing source versions and forward validity, so native interval sufficiency remains UNKNOWN. This is not evidence that native effect-time controls fail. Runtime admission and empirical comparison remain pending; see [integration handoff](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-EA-COMPONENT-v0.2/INTEGRATION.md). New coverage remains separate from frozen C3.

**Lane B — empirical coupling when access exists.** Retain the published native candidate and later select a concrete runtime/model/configuration. Codex is a possible separately registered receiver route, not a mandatory dependency or an assumed equivalent to the existing Responses API adapter. Keep the candidate's observation/action boundary and recorded events explicit so the model adapter can be exchanged without giving it hidden evaluator access. The coupling must verify view delivery, tool/action mapping, event recording and completion checks; an adapter change requires a new configuration freeze.

**Integrated scripted comparison — 1 October 2026:** [eight paired complete programmed paths](./baseline/traversals/00G-HF-SCRIPTED-PAIRED-v0.1/RESULTS.md) were executed after publishing the frozen design at `08a76f7`. Native completes 8/8 tasks; native+EA completes 7/8. Both complete the six primary cells and the acquisition-change boundary. EA fails the short-deadline continuity task because its declared processing/transport burden removes the remaining margin. All 16 paths satisfy C3's bounded safety predicates; the checker verifies all logs and expected outcomes, including that failure. Seventeen EA signals are delivered/consumed, with zero disposition changes relative to the competent conventional proposal at the same decision time. This supports a complete conditional scripted integration, not a unique EA benefit or full canonical T1–T4 closure. T1/T2/T3 evidence remains partial; T4 fails for that EA boundary. These programmed decisions are not empirical E1/E3. Do not add escalation on an assumed need: first identify an unmet requirement beyond what this native path already solves.

Complete native E1 and the prospectively paired native/EA E3 lot under the identical conditions listed below, followed by the registered reserved variants and composition comparisons. Replay Lane A traces for integration, but never relabel them as model-generated decisions. Model execution must be allowed to fail to use an otherwise correct EA signal. Independent authorship/custody and human annotation remain separate dependencies; attaching Codex does not provide them.

**Claim boundary:** Lane A can reveal an inconsistent contract, insufficient observability, lost distinctions, an ineffective signal or a conditional mechanism that works within a finite model. It cannot close empirical E1/E3/E4, establish historical causation, estimate model reliability or establish EA superiority. The “native first” ordering below governs empirical comparisons; it does not block this requirements/component work.

##### W3-HF execution gates and current position — 1 October 2026

This clarification closes the documentation gaps in the three-step response plan. It does not record an execution, appoint an external custodian, or alter the frozen C3 oracle or annotation rubric. The [main protocol §§4–10](./baseline/00G_HF_CAUSAL_NEGATIVE_TRAVERSAL_PROTOCOL_v0.3_DRAFT.md) and [C3 preparation contract §§5–6](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/ROUND1_PROTOCOL.md) remain controlling. C3 as oracle candidate is distinct from the EA experimental arm named C3 in the main protocol.

**H6 scope reconciliation.** H2–H5 are the selected hypotheses for the preliminary historical screening; they do not replace the general route. H6 remains in the [00G extensibility profile](./baseline/00G_CASE_STUDY_EXTENSIBILITY_PROFILE_v0.1.md), [traceability register L2/L5](../../architectural-contributions/ecosystem-positioning/documents/2026-09-29/traceability_audit_v04/TRACEABILITY.md) and the main protocol's H5/H6 row. Its risk/capacity-calibrated observation-window comparison is **not assessed** by that screening or by the six-cell native pilot. It needs adaptive versus fixed narrow/broad policies, comparable conditions and a full error, workload, cost and response-margin record. Message-board growth alone supplies no such comparison.

**Step 1 — matched native and EA executions.** First complete a competent native implementation and its E1 pilot. For an EA-effect claim, register a paired native/EA comparison before either member of the comparison is run: same case/world hashes, legitimate obligations, exogenous inputs and change schedule, underlying model/version, tools, native controls, S0 transport, eligible source/query access, initial state/reset policy, observation horizon, resource envelope and scoring rules. Freeze the allowed difference: EA semantic processing and signalling, with its cost charged to the EA arm. A transport/attention control follows the main protocol where needed. The same externally available evidence must be accessible to the comparator; do not give EA evaluator-private truth. Delivered messages, endogenous queries, actions and outcomes may differ because those are observations of the intervention, not fields to force equal.

Identify G0/G1 separately. Adding EA to a defended G1 must be compared with that same G1, not credited against a weaker G0. A previous native pilot can be reused as the registered counterpart only if it met the paired design prospectively and all frozen conditions match; otherwise run a new paired lot and retain the pilot as exploratory evidence. Declare repetitions, order/randomization, seeds where supported, uncontrolled service variation, stopping and uncertainty rules before results. A matching seed is not a guarantee of identical model randomness. Judge prevention, authorized continuity and useful response time, preserving native success and EA ties. The current six-episode pilot does not estimate reliability or comparative superiority.

**Step 2 — independently held-out variants and custody.** Changing variables in author-known cases is robustness exploration. A blinded claim requires the following operational record, not only a hash:

1. Name an external scenario author and a custodian in the run registration; roles may be held by the same independent person, but neither is the implementer. Record identities, independence/conflicts and permitted access. **Both appointments are currently pending.** Declare the case domain, public interface, scoring policy and permitted transformations before case selection; retain every case in the sealed lot.
2. The custodian prepares the private inputs, per-actor views, expected outcomes with rationale, case-specific adjudication data, schedule and extraction rules. Seal exact bytes with a private manifest containing each file's SHA-256, plus a fresh secret random nonce of at least 256 bits in the sealed bundle. Publish a separate commitment containing the bundle SHA-256, protocol version, opaque lot ID and an independently observable publication/timestamp reference. Do not publish low-entropy case hashes or expected answers during development. A Git author timestamp alone is not proof of publication time.
3. Publish the commitment before constructing or adapting the run-specific receiver to that lot and before any execution. Identify any pre-existing implementation and its revision honestly; do not claim a retrospective freeze before work already done. The implementation team receives only the declared public contract and separate development examples, never the reserved cases or their verdicts. Access is restricted outside the receiver's and developers' workspace; retain access and disclosure records. These are prospective custody requirements: no reserved bundle or successful blinding is claimed here.
4. Freeze candidate/native implementations, budgets, analysis and run instructions before the custodian/evaluator executes the entire lot. Deliver only the permitted temporal views to each receiver. Keep expected verdicts and future inputs hidden. Record outputs and independently captured events before adjudication; unplanned access, feedback or repair is recorded as a blinding deviation, not silently ignored.
5. After all predeclared runs, reveal the bundle/nonce and verify the commitment and file digests against the original publication, alongside access/deviation records. Hashes establish byte integrity; custody establishes restricted access, and neither proves author independence or eliminates prior model familiarity. If confidentiality prevents public release, report the independent verification route and its reproducibility limit. Cases exposed during EA testing cannot later be claimed as held out for a composition adapted from those results; reserve fresh material or freeze all candidates before any disclosure.

The native/EA fairness conditions of step 1 also apply to these reserved cases. This early reserved EA lot is registered as an addition before E4; the main protocol's E5 remains the independent validation route for the final declared scope. Scenario custody is separate from the two-pass annotation blinding in [C2](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL.md).

**Step 3 — composition under comparable resources.** EA, EA plus human escalation, EA plus incident lifecycle, and other registered additions inherit the [common-budget rule in EXPERIMENT_PROFILES §1](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.3/EXPERIMENT_PROFILES.md) and the paired conditions above. Record for every arm the ceilings and actual consumption of compute/tokens, tool/source queries, messages/bandwidth, storage where material, wall-clock time and human review/response effort. Charge EA analysis, lifecycle processing, human waiting and response to the end-to-end budget; the last useful response deadline does not move to help an arm pass.

Fix the resource-comparison rule before execution. Equal budget does not mean identical realized actions or mandatory use of every resource. Human competence, authority and availability are explicit intervention properties, not interchangeable with an arbitrary token allowance. Where the additional component also receives extra time, information, permissions or resources that cannot be matched under the registered comparison, report the result as **composition plus additional resources**, with incremental cost; do not attribute a same-budget advantage to the component alone. Keep the task and independently defined success criteria unchanged. Add one component at a time and predeclare relevant interaction contrasts; for an EA-necessity claim within a composition, include the same composition without EA semantics. None of these additions is assumed necessary before observation.

**Negative software witness completed; empirical witness still pending:** the [cached-lineage reference and repair lot](./baseline/traversals/00G-HF-CACHED-LINEAGE-v0.1/RESULTS.md), frozen at `3a5573c` before execution, reproduces the operational defect in three primary F branches and preserves the three matched G branches with EA. Conventional fresh revalidation also resolves those pairs at lower logical cost. Ten native paths and fifty matched paths are preserved, with 21/21 and 120/120 author verification checks; native repeats are not independent evidence. Across all ten cases: cached 6/10 tasks, EA 8/10, fresh 9/10. Missing provenance and a short deadline expose continuity losses. This is a new deterministic application profile with an explicit cache defect; earlier effect-guarded native controls are unchanged. It is not an external competitor failure or full T1–T4 validation. **Next empirical action:** the [decision-open model receiver](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-MODEL-RECEIVER-v0.1/README.md) now imports the unchanged cached-lineage environment and provides native/raw-evidence/EA arms. Its 17/17 offline integration checks pass; the access check records zero API requests and an incomplete registration because credentials/model selection are absent. Configure an authorized model and endpoint access, then execute the native lot; only an observed eligible model failure opens its repair comparison. The receiving model can revalidate without EA or ignore EA. Original multi-agent frame capture and [the wider failure design](./baseline/00G_HF_NEGATIVE_WITNESS_FIRST_v0.1_DRAFT.md) remain separate pending scope. Do not substitute harness checks for E1/E3 or claim superiority over the successful fresh comparator.

**Current diagnostic result — 1 October 2026:** [Actual Casbin polling comparator under unchanged C3](./baseline/traversals/00G-HF-CASBIN-POLLING-v0.1/README.md) now supplies the requested negative programmed traversal: mandate-aware PyCasbin 1.43.0 checks commitment/request/effect against a stale local policy and fails REVOKED with `hf_operational_witness=true`. EA with timely programmed response repairs it; ordinary policy reload also repairs it and finishes earlier. All arms pass four continuity/boundary controls. 25 complete case/arm records, 154/154 verification checks, zero model decisions. This is an author-configured diagnostic comparator, not a defended strongest-peer benchmark. **Methodological correction:** the cached-lineage experiment and its model adapter above use their own simplified oracle, not C3; their files/results remain auxiliary. Model credentials are not a blocker for this completed programmed C3 comparison. Pending: independently defended comparators and autonomous decisions only for claims that require them.

**Earlier preparation snapshot — 1 October 2026 (implementation status superseded by the native update above):** [oracle C3 / v0.4 and bounded first-round protocol](./baseline/fixtures/00G-HF-ORACLE-v0.4/CANDIDATE.md) now provide the preparation route beyond C1/C2. Pending work is to select/confirm a concrete receiver, implement the recorder and completion checks, freeze literal inputs/views/resources and run six exploratory cells covering authority and evidence applicability. The package verifies 102 constructed oracle controls; no agent runs or H2–H5 validation. Source-dependence changes, control-removal studies and population evaluation remain later work; C1 references below retain the lineage of the hypothesis-screening plan.

**Documentary traversal completed; live run still pending — 1 October 2026:** [six separately sourced historical evidence units](./baseline/traversals/00G-HF-HISTORICAL-REVIEW-2026-10-01/README.md), including two restraint cases, were reviewed against C3's evidence requirements. **Canonical statements.** The following English wording is retained from [00, §4](./baseline/00_CANONICAL_REQUIREMENTS_CHALLENGES_SUFFICIENCY_HYPOTHESES_KPIS.md#4-foundational-hypotheses-h1h6); it supersedes the abbreviated translations for this work item, without changing the canonical source.

| Hypothesis | Canonical statement |
|---|---|
| H2 — Residual-scope explicitness | Separating confidence conditional on U from the open residual `R_U` beyond that bounded representation will reduce unjustified local-to-global confidence inflation in downstream decisions. |
| H3 — Compositional residual expansion | Under comparable evidence and computational resources, systems whose critical downstream decisions depend solely on lossy compressed representations will exhibit greater hidden residual and/or false confidence than systems with better context preservation or independent-source access. |
| H4 — Bounded preservation | A bounded determinacy/context envelope can preserve enough decision-relevant information to reduce architecture-induced residual without requiring disclosure of full internal state. |
| H5 — Dynamic ecosystem pressure | For a fixed observation and verification budget, increasing participant/dependency churn and shortening ecosystem-state validity will increase the operational importance of residual-state preservation and requalification even when local algorithms remain unchanged. |

U is a bounded representation, not simply everything known with certainty. Information received from a peer is not necessarily lossy compression. H4 concerns preservation of decision-relevant information, not a guarantee that an informed recipient will act correctly. H5 requires a temporal validity/churn contrast at fixed observation and verification budget, not merely a larger group.

1. **H2 first, using the scorer interpretation.** Select a specific receiving decision and preserve source, message, time, available evidence, stated uncertainty and observable downstream conclusion/action. 2. **H4 next, using the material distinctions identified in that same decision.** Fix the envelope's fields and size before observing the recipient. 3. **H3 only after identifying loss.** Record the before/after representations and the omitted decision-relevant distinction. Compare lossy-only reliance with better preservation or independent-source access under comparable evidence and computational resources. If the false claim was transmitted intact, retain that trajectory for other questions and do not label it an H3 compression witness.
4. **H5 after locating a temporal witness.** Establish a previously applicable basis, independently recorded material change, and later reuse. For an experimental extension, vary participant/dependency churn and state validity while holding the local algorithm and observation/verification budget fixed; compare preservation/requalification conditions and retain unchanged-context controls.
